note: FRED: US interest-rate series from the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.
title: FRED interest-rate series
description: Observations of chosen FRED series (default: effective federal funds rate, 2- and 10-year Treasury yields and their spread), the rate backdrop of the bank-stress demonstrations. Values are the current vintage; FRED's archive (ALFRED) holds earlier vintages if exact rewinds of revised series are needed.

sources.title: FRED series observations API
sources.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
sources.license: Free with an API key; each series under its owner's terms
sources.known_at_rule: End of the observation's period plus one day (basis proxy_publication_lag).
